bullets.text: Velachery residents demanded a permanent scientifically-validated flood mitigation plan rather than relying only on emergency pumping.
Avadi homes experienced heavy rain and flooding with rainwater entering residential properties.
Rain caused hazardous conditions on the Tambaram-Velachery road where an ambulance overturned and injured its driver.
Chennai recorded 70mm of rainfall leaving streets waterlogged with ankle-deep stagnant water that disrupted traffic.
Widespread rains lashed Chennai continuously from Wednesday morning under the ongoing northeast monsoon.
Heavy rains prompted authorities to declare a holiday for schools in Thiruvallur and neighboring districts on Wednesday.
A cab driver in Avadi disguised himself in a green churidar to rob an elderly woman before being caught by CCTV.
MLA Ko. Ari provided financial assistance to Tharanthika, a student from Thiruttani participating in a national Tang Soo Do competition.
US cloud AI provider Vultr announced plans to build a 20 MW data centre in Chennai deploying AMD Instinct accelerators.
The Ministry of Information and Broadcasting warned private satellite TV channels against misusing AI in news broadcasting.
AI researchers uncovered a critical security flaw named PHP2Shell that leaves up to 70 percent of world websites vulnerable.
Chief Minister Vijay launched a rainwater harvesting awareness campaign to emphasize the importance of water conservation.
